title: Generating collective spin cat states via photon-number measurements near the Dicke critical point
summary: We propose a method for generating collective spin cat states in a cavity-coupled atomic ensemble by exploiting strong light-matter entanglement and anti-squeezing associated with the superradiant phase transition. We numerically and analytically demonstrate that the cat states can be heralded by photon-number measurement on the ground state of the Dicke model. The near-critical regime enhances both the cat-state size and the probability of obtaining larger photon-number outcomes, and outcomes with larger photon numbers yield even larger cat states.
